title: The Choir of Harrow Glen
author: J. M. Joubert
blurb: Astrid Almeida, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
